label.scanDirs: Model scan folders (right-click to remove; built-in ones are locked)
label.emptyModels: Library is empty. Use "Import model" or "Scan directories".
label.apiEnabledHint: When off, no key is passed to llama-server (handy for local debugging)
label.confirmRemove: Remove this model from the list? (file stays on disk)
label.starting: Server is starting; first load of a large model can take a while…
label.noModelInFolder: No .gguf model found in that folder (subfolders included)
label.autoParamsMore: full list in Explain args; others via extra CLI args

hint.alias: Model name used by the API; empty means the file path
hint.ctxSize: 0 = derived from model metadata; larger uses more VRAM
hint.ctxAuto: When checked, switching models resets the context to that model's native maximum
hint.nGpuLayers: 99 means offload as many layers as possible
hint.parallel: Concurrent requests; raise for parallel agents
hint.lanOpen: Other devices on the LAN can reach the API
hint.host: Empty = decided by the switch above (127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0)
hint.apiKeyEnabled: When off, clients can call without a key
hint.apiKeys: One per line; commas also work
hint.batchSize: Prompt batch size; too large may exhaust VRAM
hint.ubatchSize: Physical batch; lower it when VRAM is tight
hint.splitMode: How the model is spread across GPUs
hint.nCpuMoe: Keep experts of the first N layers on CPU when VRAM is low
hint.builtinUi: Off by default to save memory; use this tool's test chat instead
hint.slots: Lets monitoring tools read slot state
hint.embeddings: Only for embedding models, not generation
hint.noWarmup: Skips startup warmup for faster start
hint.maxOutput: 0 = auto: 16384 for thinking models, engine default otherwise
hint.ropeScaling: Used instead of plain extrapolation when context exceeds the model maximum; auto = leave it to the engine
hint.yarnOrigCtx: 0 = use the model's own training context; rarely needs changing
hint.chatTemplateFile: Jinja template path; empty uses the model's built-in
hint.endpoint: Other devices on your LAN can call this address (enable LAN access first)
hint.copyEndpoint: Copy the endpoint to the clipboard
hint.newKey: Generate a new key and clear the old ones
hint.logPane: llama-server output and errors show up here in real time
hint.import: Pick a .gguf model file and add it to the library
hint.importFolder: Pick a folder; models inside (subfolders and vision models too) are detected
hint.scan: Scan common model folders for gguf files
hint.start: Start llama-server with the current settings
hint.chat: Open the standalone chat page in your browser
hint.advanced: Less common options: batching, sampling, cache
hint.save: Write all current settings to the config file
hint.modelList: Click to choose the model to load; red items are unsupported
hint.mmproj: Projector for vision models; auto-filled when a vision model is selected. Empty means no image input.
hint.vision: Vision models load the projector; uncheck to run text-only
hint.tokens: Prompt / generated tokens processed by llama-server since this start
hint.llamaExe: Leave empty to auto-detect llama-server.exe near the program; use Browse… to pick manually
hint.paramHelp: Break the current launch arguments down, with EN/CN meanings
hint.autoParams: Discovered from the current llama-server --help. Values are appended to the launch arguments; leave empty to skip.
hint.translating: Translating parameter docs with the local model
hint.translateNothing: All current parameters already have Chinese descriptions
hint.autoTranslate: After a llama-server upgrade, translate new parameter docs once when the server is idle
hint.autoFilter: Type to filter parameter names, e.g. cors or template
hint.builtinDirLocked: Built-in folder (relative path) cannot be removed
hint.llamaDownload: Open the llama.cpp releases page to download the latest llama-server
hint.modelChangedWhileRunning: Model selection changed; the server still runs the previous model. Stop the service, then start it to switch.
hint.profileApplied: Profile applied; start the service to take effect
hint.estimateNote: Estimates only; actual usage differs by roughly 2-10%
hint.mtp: When the model ships MTP (multi-token prediction) layers, --spec-type draft-mtp predicts several tokens at once; measured 30-40% faster generation. No effect if the model has no MTP layers.
hint.engine: llama.cpp: the native engine, works with any GGUF. KVMem: keeps the full KV history in RAM/SSD so long contexts cost far less VRAM; needs KVMem's separate llama.cpp package (llama-kvmem-server.exe) in the app folder. Selecting a model auto-picks the engine by size (>8 GB goes to KVMem); you can override it here.
hint.engineMissing: No usable engine for this model - use Get KVMem or Get llama to download one

err.modelNotSelected: Select a model on the left first
err.exeNotFound: llama-server not found; set its path in Advanced
err.startTimeout: Startup timed out, check the log
err.unknownArch: Architecture {arch} is not supported by the bundled llama-server (b12549). Update llama.cpp or use a compatible model file.
err.noLlamaServer: llama-server not found; pick it in Advanced settings → llama-server path
err.tensorMismatch: This model is incompatible with the current llama.cpp build: tensor {tensor} is missing. Usually the model is newer than llama.cpp (or uses new features such as looped layers). Update llama.cpp, or use a quant this build can load.
err.kvmemNotFound: KVMem engine not found: put KVMem's llama-kvmem-server.exe in the app folder, or switch back to llama.cpp here
err.ninferNotFound: NInfer engine not found: download KVMem's NInfer package (containing infer-kvmem-server.exe) into the app folder, or pick another engine

chat.title: Test chat
chat.placeholder: Type a message, Ctrl+Enter to send
chat.reasoningOnly: (The model spent the whole output budget on reasoning and produced no answer. Raise max output in advanced settings.)
chat.empty: Start the server in the panel first
chat.imageHint: Pick an image, or paste / drop one into the input box
chat.visionOff: Vision is off for this model; images will not be sent

warn.ctxTooSmall: Note: context size is only {cur} tokens (model supports up to {native}). Agent frameworks reserve ~1500 completion + 65536 compaction headroom, so a window below 67000 fails outright; set Context size to 131072.
warn.vramRisk: ⚠ VRAM is nearly full - risk of running out of memory: enable KV quantization (-ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0) or use a KVMem engine

help.header:
These are the arguments this build will pass to llama-server, explained one by one.
Descriptions are based on the official --help of the bundled llama.cpp (b12549). Lines starting with * are the flag and its value; the next two lines give the Chinese explanation and the official English text.
Scroll with the wheel or the scrollbar on the right to see every argument.
